specifications.metric: WirelessHART mesh installation cost saving vs wired instruments
specifications.basis: Quoted on the WirelessHART technology page from the 'WirelessHART User Case Studies - web publishing' brochure: 'WirelessHART offers 30%-60% lower installation costs than adding traditional wired instruments'

As printed on the page: 'By design, WirelessHART using mesh networking technology' and 'a device doesn't have to communicate directly to a gateway, but just forward its message to the next closest device'
specifications.value: self-organizing, self-healing mesh; each device can route for other devices
